strings.onboarding.label: GETTING STARTED
strings.onboarding.setup.0.title: Choose your language
strings.onboarding.setup.0.body: Menus, guides and settings will use your chosen language.
strings.onboarding.setup.1.title: Choose where music plays
strings.onboarding.setup.1.body: Shared output works for everyday listening. Exclusive and ASIO output require a suitable device and driver.
strings.onboarding.setup.2.title: Make yourself at home
strings.onboarding.setup.2.body: Choose light, dark, or follow your system appearance.
strings.onboarding.setup.3.title: A few everyday controls
strings.onboarding.setup.3.body: These are your current shortcuts. You can edit them in Settings.
strings.onboarding.setup.4.title: Ready for your first song
strings.onboarding.setup.4.body: Apply the settings you changed, then explore the player.

strings.onboarding.appearance.preview: Your music, in a look you like.

strings.onboarding.daily.hint: Use the player bar to pause, skip or seek. Click the cover for lyrics. Audio and lyric settings are at the top of the window.
strings.onboarding.summary.hint: Every tour step is optional. Press Esc to leave anytime.
strings.onboarding.guide.label: PLAYER TOUR
strings.onboarding.guide.welcome.title: Start with your first song.
strings.onboarding.guide.welcome.body: Explore importing music, playback, the queue and lyrics. Skip any step or press Esc to leave.
strings.onboarding.guide.songs.title: Find your music
strings.onboarding.guide.songs.body: Songs shows your library. Search, filter and sort above the list.
strings.onboarding.guide.import.title: Add your music here
strings.onboarding.guide.import.body: Open … above the list and choose Import Folder. Tracks appear after scanning. Continue if you already have a library or have no files handy.
strings.onboarding.guide.play.title: Play a song
strings.onboarding.guide.play.body: Double-click a track, or select it and press Enter to play. Skip this step if the library is empty.
strings.onboarding.guide.controls.title: Your playback controls
strings.onboarding.guide.controls.body: Play or pause in the center, and change tracks on either side. Use the heart to save a favorite. These controls affect real playback.
strings.onboarding.guide.progress.title: Jump to a favorite moment
strings.onboarding.guide.progress.body: Click or drag the progress bar to seek. Volume is on the right of the player bar. Skip if nothing is playing.
strings.onboarding.guide.queue.title: See what plays next
strings.onboarding.guide.queue.body: Open the queue from the player bar to see what plays now and next.
strings.onboarding.guide.queue-list.title: Manage your listening order
strings.onboarding.guide.queue-list.body: The queue sets your listening order; playlists save collections. A track menu offers Add to Queue and Play Next.
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics.title: Open the lyrics view
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics.body: Click the cover or Lyrics button in the player bar. Your music keeps playing even when lyrics are unavailable.
strings.onboarding.guide.visuals.title: Make the view your own
strings.onboarding.guide.visuals.body: Open lyric settings at the top to adjust text, styles, backgrounds and word highlighting.
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics-style.title: Choose a lyric style
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics-style.body: Choose a lyric layout in the style tab, or continue to keep your current look.
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics-background.title: Adjust the lyric background
strings.onboarding.guide.lyrics-background.body: Choose an effect in the style tab’s background settings and adjust its controls.
strings.onboarding.guide.settings.title: Find a setting
strings.onboarding.guide.settings.body: Open Settings at the top for general, playback, appearance and lyric options.
strings.onboarding.guide.categories.title: Explore settings by category
strings.onboarding.guide.categories.body: Browse categories or search for a setting. Both setup and this tour are under General → Language and guidance.
strings.onboarding.guide.finish.title: Time for your favorite music
strings.onboarding.guide.finish.body: Reopen this tour from More at the top or Settings → General anytime.

strings.signal.title: Signal path
strings.signal.levelNote: Measured native Host level. Stale readings clear on pause, track changes or missing frames.
strings.signal.noMeter: No valid level frame for the current playback.
strings.signal.unconfirmed: Actual device output is unconfirmed; settings are verified during playback.
strings.signal.conversionOn: Sample rate or format processing is active
strings.signal.sharedNote: Shared output passes through the system mixer. Matching rates do not prove bit-perfect.
strings.signal.modifiedNote: DSP, format processing or software volume can modify samples. Device capability and live output are separate facts.
strings.signal.bitPerfectNote: Device output is confirmed. Bit-perfect still requires authoritative native output evidence.
strings.signal.insightWaitingDetail: Path notes appear after playback confirms a device.
strings.signal.insightWaitingAdvice: Select a track and play it.
strings.signal.insightErrorAdvice: Check the output device and retry.
strings.signal.insightResampleDetail: The source clock and the confirmed device clock differ.
strings.signal.insightResampleAdvice: Conversion stays until the device rate matches the source.
strings.signal.insightSdmAdvice: This path changes the original PCM samples.
strings.signal.insightLevelAdvice: Lower volume or gain before the level reaches 0 dBFS.
strings.signal.insightLimiterDetail: Output is held under the limiter ceiling.
strings.signal.insightLimiterAdvice: Reduce preamp gain to avoid sustained limiting.
strings.signal.insightBitDetail: The native flag does not report sample-rate or DSP rewriting.
strings.signal.insightBitAdvice: Confirmed device output remains the authority.
strings.signal.insightNotBitAdvice: Shared mixing, DSP, volume or rate conversion changes samples.
strings.signal.stabilityClean: No fallback or sample-rate conflict reported.
strings.signal.stabilityFallbackDetail: The confirmed mode differs from the request.
strings.signal.stageDspNote: Equalizer and convolution modules rewrite samples before output.
strings.signal.stageDeviceNote: The device clock differs from the source; the system or device converts.
strings.signal.stageVolumeNote: Software volume changes the samples sent.
